}}'''Clintock''' is a [[Redarm]] in the [[Band of the Red Hand]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Clintock}}

== Activities ==
He checks on [[Matrim Cauthon]] every half hour due to feeling shame in failing to notice the ''[[gholam]]'' entering their camp.
